levels.name: Foundation

levels.notes: Bandwidth caps: 7100-7300 <=8 kHz; >8 kHz (HF) or >16 kHz (10m) limited to 1 W/100 kHz PSD. No class-based mode limits.

jurisdictions.callsignInference: 2-letter suffix (VKnXX) or 2x1 contest call => Advanced (high). 3-letter suffix => any level (none). Legacy VKnFxxx => Foundation at issue, may have upgraded (lower bound only).

levels.name: 1st Class

jurisdictions.callsignInference: None from the call sign. The station licence's 一括表示記号 (1AF/1AM...4AF/4AM) encodes the class if the user enters it.

levels.name: Class A

levels.name: Class B (obtained before 2024-03-01)

levels.notes: Same bands as Class B; Order 67 Art. 58 grandfathers the higher HF power.

levels.name: Class C
levels.powerNote: <=1000 W below 30 MHz; <=25 W above 30 MHz
levels.notes: Same bands as Class B. National exam only; requires >=18 months with an HF-endorsed licence.

jurisdictions.callsignInference: None. Type letter (G,H,I,D,A,B,C,E,F,K,L) is assigned sequentially, not by class.

levels.name: Class C
levels.powerNote: 25 W PEP at final amplifier output
levels.notes: FM only (F1D,F1E,F2D,F3E,FXD,FXE). Entry level since 2023.

levels.name: Class B

levels.notes: No 2200/630/160m or microwave.

levels.name: Class A
levels.powerNote: 1000 W PEP HF; 500 W 6m; 50 W 2m/70cm/microwave; 25 W 241-250 GHz; 1 W EIRP 2200m, 5 W EIRP 630m, 15 W EIRP 60m

jurisdictions.callsignInference: Prefix encodes class: 9W3=C; 9W2/9W6/9W8=B; 9M2/9M6/9M8=A (high). Exclude special/club calls (e.g. 9M4) and 9M0.

levels.name: 4th Class
levels.powerNote: <=10 W antenna supply power; >=30 MHz only; no Morse
levels.notes: No CW. Also 24/47/75.5/142/248 GHz bands.

levels.name: 3rd Class (Telephony)

levels.notes: No CW. Microwave bands as 4th class.

levels.name: 3rd Class (Telegraphy)
levels.powerNote: <=100 W; only <=8 MHz or >=21 MHz
levels.notes: No 10/14/18 MHz. Microwave bands as 4th class.

levels.name: 2nd Class
levels.powerNote: <=200 W; mobile <=50 W

levels.name: 1st Class
levels.powerNote: <=1 kW; mobile <=50 W
levels.notes: Same bands as 2nd class.

jurisdictions.callsignInference: None; HL/DS/6K-6N/D7-D9 series and digits indicate region/series, not class.

levels.name: Restricted
levels.powerNote: 50 W DC input to final stage on HF; 10 W on VHF/UHF
levels.notes: HF phone only (A3E/H3E/J3E/R3E); VHF/UHF F1B/F2B/F3E/F3C. Legacy Grade II holders (migrated here) may also use A1A/A2A (CW).

levels.name: General
levels.powerNote: 400 W DC input on HF; 25 W VHF/UHF/5.7 GHz; satellite 30 dBW EIRP
levels.notes: Legacy Grade I and Advanced map here.

levels.name: Grade II (legacy)
levels.powerNote: as Restricted
levels.notes: Migrates to Restricted; keeps A1A/A2A (CW) on Restricted bands.

levels.name: Grade I / Advanced (legacy)
levels.powerNote: as General
levels.notes: Migrates to General.

jurisdictions.callsignInference: Since 2009, new VU3 = Restricted, new VU2 = General. Pre-2009 VU2 calls were issued to all grades, so VU2 alone is not proof of General (low); VU3 suggests Restricted (medium).

levels.name: General
levels.powerNote: 100 W below 30 MHz, 75 W above (effective power to antenna)
levels.notes: Prefix YD/YG.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.powerNote: 500 W below 30 MHz, 200 W above

levels.name: Extra Class
levels.powerNote: 1000 W below 30 MHz, 500 W above; 60m 15 W; up to 2000 W by special permit
levels.notes: Prefix YB/YE.

jurisdictions.callsignInference: Prefix encodes tier by regulation: YD/YG=Siaga, YC/YF=Penggalang, YB/YE=Penegak (high). YH and 7A-7I/8A-8I are special-purpose.

levels.name: Class B
levels.powerNote: 20 dBW (100 W) HF/2m/70cm; 630m 5 W EIRP; 6m 30/26 dBW as printed (likely error); 29.7-30 and 40.68 MHz 26 dBW
levels.notes: Only issued to persons aged <=20; cancelled unless Class A passed by 25th birthday.

levels.name: Class A
levels.powerNote: 30 dBW (1 kW) primary HF/6m/2m/70cm/23cm; 26 dBW (~400 W) secondary bands; 2200m 1 W EIRP, 630m 5 W EIRP
levels.notes: 60m (5351.5-5366.5 at 15 W EIRP; NRFP 5350-5450 + 5290) allocated in NRFP 2018 but Annexure I not updated as of 2021 - unconfirmed.

levels.name: Former restricted (ZR)
levels.powerNote: as Class A
levels.notes: Merged into Class A; full Class A privileges.

jurisdictions.callsignInference: ZU => Class B (high); ZS or ZR => Class A (high).

levels.name: Class N
levels.powerNote: 10 W ERP on 10 m; 6.1 W ERP on 2 m and 70 cm
levels.notes: Introduced by AFuV amendment in force 24 Jun 2024. Not CEPT-recognised. Personal calls DN9xx.

levels.name: Class E
levels.powerNote: PEP. 100 W HF, 75 W 2m/70cm/23cm, 5 W >=2.3 GHz
levels.notes: Legacy Klasse 3 = E (AFuV §19). Personal calls DO1-DO9, DA6.

levels.name: Class A
levels.powerNote: PEP; 75 W PEP >=2.3 GHz; ERP limits on LF/MF/60m

bands.powerNote: 1 W ERP; 800 Hz max bandwidth; site notification
9.14 W ERP (15 W EIRP); 2.7 kHz bandwidth
750 W PEP 50.0-50.4 MHz; 25 W PEP 50.4-52 MHz; fixed stations, horizontal polarisation only

levels.notes: Legacy Klasse 1, Klasse 2 and all other pre-2005 classes (incl. DDR) = A (AFuV §19).

jurisdictions.callsignInference: Rufzeichenplan Vfg 15/2025: DN9 = N; DO1-DO9 and DA6 = E; DA1, DA2, DB1-9, DC, DD, DF1-9, DG, DH, DJ, DK1-9, DL1-9, DM1-9 = A. DN1-DN8 are expiring training calls (valid to 2028-12-31). Club and repeater series (DA0, DF0, DK0, DL0, DB0, DM0, DO0, DA7, DA8, DP*, DR*) are not personal. Reliable for issue-time class; upgrade retention not verified.

levels.name: Class 3
levels.powerNote: PEP (Leistungsstufe A); commercial unmodified equipment only
levels.notes: National entry class, valid only in Austria.

levels.name: Class 4
levels.powerNote: PEP (Leistungsstufe A); commercial unmodified equipment only
levels.notes: CEPT Novice equivalent (AFV §3(3)).

levels.name: Class 1
levels.powerNote: PEP; per licensed Leistungsstufe A 100 / B 200 / C 400 W; 1000 W High Power on application on 80/40/20/17/15/12/10 m after 1 year; non-HP bands 200 W

bands.powerNote: 200 W 50-52 MHz; 100 W 52-54 MHz (R&D projects, temporary)
1 kW for EME/MS with >=15 dBd antennas

levels.notes: Legacy Klasse 2 and pre-1999 licences = Class 1 (AFV §46).

jurisdictions.callsignInference: Not inferable: OE + region digit + 1 or 3 letters for all classes (AFV §5). X after the digit = club/repeater/beacon.

levels.name: Class N (Novice)
levels.powerNote: output power
levels.notes: Segments must follow IARU Region 1 band plan (§4(3)). Personal calls OK9xxx.

levels.name: Class A
levels.powerNote: output power (ČTÚ: PEP); 1500 W (3000 W outside built-up areas) in international contests and EME
levels.notes: 630 m, 60 m, 4 m not in decree 156/2005 (individual permits unverified).

jurisdictions.callsignInference: Vyhláška 155/2005 §9(3)(j): OK9 + 3 letters = class N; OK1-OK7 + 2/3 letters (excluding OK1/OK2 + K/O/R club block) = class A; OK8 = foreigners; OK0 = unattended; OL = special events. Reliable for issue-time class.

jurisdictions.regulator: RÚ (Úrad pre reguláciu elektronických komunikácií a poštových služieb)

levels.name: Class N (Novice)
levels.powerNote: UNVERIFIED: set in individual permit; 100 W per 2007 conditions and 2022 draft
levels.notes: Band set per 2007 Table 2 (narrower sub-bands then); current permit band set unverified - the 2022 draft would allow all bands. Treat as low confidence.

levels.name: Class E
levels.powerNote: UNVERIFIED: set in individual permit; 750 W per 2007 conditions and 2022 draft
levels.notes: Band plan (mode per segment) is in decree 291/2022 Annex 1 and applies to all classes; microwave bands also listed in Annex 1 Tables 3-5 (not itemised here).

jurisdictions.callsignInference: Decree 291/2022 Annex 2: 2-letter suffix = E; 3-letter suffix AAA-JZZ = N. But N->E upgrade keeps the call (§10(2)) and pre-Sept-2022 calls remain valid, so a 3-letter suffix does not reliably mean N.

levels.name: Category 3
levels.powerNote: transmitter output power
levels.notes: 30/17/12 m added by Dz.U. 2026 poz. 406 (in force 2026-05-01); under the 2015 rules category 3 lacked them. Legacy certificates class C and D qualify.

levels.name: Category 1
levels.powerNote: transmitter output power; up to 1500 W with a separate 'pozwolenie dodatkowe' for contests/occasional use
levels.notes: Regulation grants ALL amateur allocations in Poland; LF/MF/60m/6m/4m/microwave availability and caps come from KTPCz (not verified, not itemised). Legacy certificates class A and B qualify.

jurisdictions.callsignInference: Not inferable. Any of HF/SN/SO/SP/SQ/3Z + digit + up to 4 chars; SR reserved for unattended (category 5) stations.

levels.name: Beginner (Kezdő)
levels.powerNote: transmitter power; 100 W HF, 50 W 2m/70cm, 10 W 430-432 MHz and 23 cm
levels.notes: Issued only to applicants under 18 or 60 and over (15/2013 §8(6)). National grade, no CEPT equivalence.

levels.name: CEPT Novice
levels.powerNote: transmitter power; 200 W HF and 2 m, 100 W 70 cm, 50 W 23 cm FM segments
levels.notes: From Alap exam or foreign CEPT Novice. Legacy RA (+Morse), URH, UA certificates map to Alap.

levels.name: CEPT (full)
levels.powerNote: transmitter power; 1500 W HF, 1000 W 2m/70cm, 500 W 23cm, 150 W 13cm, 75 W 6/3cm, 30 W >=24 GHz
levels.notes: From HAREC exam. Legacy RB/RC (+Morse), UB/UC certificates map to HAREC. Hand-keyed CW requires Morse exam (NFFF 7.1.2).

jurisdictions.callsignInference: Not inferable: HA/HG + digit + letters, 5-7 chars, no grade series (15/2013 §12). NMHH public call-sign register lists the grade.

jurisdictions.regulator: AKOS (Agencija za komunikacijska omrežja in storitve RS)

levels.name: Class N (Novice)
levels.powerNote: MEAN power; 100 W HF, 25 W VHF/UHF
levels.notes: No satellite-service use (Art. 4(2)). Calls S52xxx / S58xxx.

levels.name: Class A
levels.powerNote: MEAN power; per-band caps

jurisdictions.callsignInference: Art. 6 Tabela 2: S52AAA-S52XZZ, S52ZAA-S52ZZZ, S58AAA-S58XZZ = class N; S50/S51-S59 2-letter and S50, S54, S56, S57, S58Z 3-letter blocks = class A; S51/S53/S59 3-letter = clubs; S55 = repeaters/beacons. Medium reliability (call changes allowed after 5 years; pre-2023 calls).

jurisdictions.regulator: HAKOM (Hrvatska regulatorna agencija za mrežne djelatnosti)

levels.name: Class P (Beginner)
levels.powerNote: PEP

levels.name: Class A
levels.powerNote: PEP
levels.notes: Legacy class B and C exams recognised as A (Art. 10(6)).

jurisdictions.callsignInference: Not inferable: 9A + digit + up to 3 letters for all classes (Art. 15).

jurisdictions.rules: Resolución ENACOM 3635-E/2017 (Reglamento General de Radioaficionados, Anexo A band plan) as amended by Res. ENACOM 1186/2024

levels.name: Novice
levels.powerNote: RF carrier power (mean, transmitter output); AM 70%; EME 2000 W; 60m 25 W EIRP; 2200m 1 W EIRP; 630m 5 W EIRP
levels.notes: No 30m, 17m or 12m. 15m 21200-21310 and 10m 29300-29510 only via satellite; 10m 28300-28350 DX contacts only; 432.08-432.10 MHz weak-signal, 1 W max. Within each range the band plan's per-segment mode rules apply to all categories.

levels.name: General
levels.powerNote: RF carrier power (mean, transmitter output); AM 70%; EME 2000 W; band EIRP caps as Novice
levels.notes: No 30m; no 15m 21250-21450 (21250-21310 satellite only). 10m 28300-28350 DX only and 29300-29510 satellite only. Former Res.50/98 'Intermedia' holders are General.

levels.name: Superior
levels.powerNote: RF carrier power (mean, transmitter output); AM 70%; EME 2000 W; 30m max 250 W; band EIRP caps as Novice
levels.notes: All bands. 30m: CW 10100-10130, CW/digital 10130-10150, 250 W, no contests. Radio clubs are licensed Superior.

levels.name: Special
levels.powerNote: Same as Superior
levels.notes: Honorific: Superior + 20 consecutive years. 'No otorga prerrogativa alguna con respecto a la categoría SUPERIOR' (§4.8). Use Superior's band table. Code 'E' is unofficial.

levels.name: Initial (legacy)
levels.powerNote: Converted to Novicio
levels.notes: Res. SC 50/1998 category; converted to Novicio by Res. 3635/2017 §14.1.1.1. Use Novicio privileges.

levels.name: Intermediate (legacy)
levels.powerNote: Converted to General
levels.notes: Res. SC 50/1998 category; converted to General by §14.1.1.3. Use General privileges.

jurisdictions.callsignInference: Not inferable. Suffix letters encode the province, not the category. A two-letter suffix may be granted on request only to Superior/Especial (§8.3), so a 2-letter suffix weakly suggests Superior/Especial; pre-2018 calls were kept unchanged, so this is not reliable.

jurisdictions.rules: Res. Anatel 777/2025 (RGST) Art. 277 (classes); Ato SOR 926/2024 (bands/power by class); Ato 3448/2026 (operations, exams, callsigns)

levels.name: Class C
levels.powerNote: Mean transmitter output power over duty cycle; 2200m 1 W EIRP, 630m 5 W EIRP
levels.notes: No 60/30/20/17m; 160m only 1800-1850; 80m only to 3800; 40m only 7000-7047; 15m only 21000-21150. mm-wave bands (47, 76-81.5, 122.25-123, 134-141, 241-250 GHz) also all classes. Ex-Class D holders migrated here.

levels.name: Class B
levels.powerNote: Mean transmitter output power over duty cycle; EIRP caps as Class C
levels.notes: No 60/30/20/17m; 160m only to 1850; 80m only to 3800; 15m only to 21300.

levels.name: Class A
levels.powerNote: Mean transmitter output power over duty cycle; 60m 25 W EIRP; 2200m 1 W EIRP; 630m 5 W EIRP
levels.notes: All bands. Per-segment mode rules (Ato 926 §7) are not class-dependent.

levels.name: Class D (legacy)
levels.powerNote: Migrated to Class C
levels.notes: Abolished by Res. 449/2006; mandatory migration to Class C by ~Jan 2012 (Res. 541/2010). Treat as Class C.

jurisdictions.callsignInference: PU + digit + 3 letters (and PV2KAA-PV2YZZ in São Paulo) = Class C (high reliability). PY/PP/PT/PQ/PR/PS/PV/PW + digit + 2-3 letters = Class A or B (cannot distinguish). Special calls: PP-PX special prefixes = Class A only; ZV-ZZ with suffix starting 'W' = Class C. Suffix starting 'Z' = foreign resident.

jurisdictions.rules: Decreto 1078 de 2015 (DUR-TIC) Libro 2 Parte 2 Título 5, compiling Decreto 963 de 2009

levels.name: Second Category / Novice
levels.powerNote: PEP into antenna feed line: HF fixed 100 W, HF mobile 50 W, MF (160m) 200 W, VHF 25 W, UHF 25 W; no SHF/EHF
levels.notes: Code 'N' unofficial. No data/RTTY emissions listed for Novice. No 60/30/20/17/12m, no 1.25m, nothing above 440 MHz. HJ prefix.

levels.notes: All bands allocated in the CNABF; edges here are ITU/IARU R2 assumptions (CNABF not fetched). 60m unverified. HK prefix. Code 'E' unofficial.

levels.name: Advanced

jurisdictions.callsignInference: HJ + digit + 1-3 letters = Novice (Segunda). HK + digit + 1-3 letters = Expert or Advanced (indistinguishable); associations also HK. 5J/5K = special/temporary, level unknown.

jurisdictions.rules: DS 523/2006 (Reglamento del Servicio de Aficionados a las Radiocomunicaciones) as amended by DS 213/2012; Res. Exenta 1228/2008 + 175/2014 (callsigns); DS 127/2006 + DS 192/2023 (band plan)

levels.name: Aspirant
levels.powerNote: HF 100 W PEP at feed-line input, fixed station only; 144 MHz 50 W fixed or mobile
levels.notes: Code unofficial. HF fixed stations only; under-15s need supervision for HF. CD prefix.

levels.name: Novice
levels.powerNote: Fixed: HF 200 W PEP, VHF 50 W, UHF<=1270 MHz 25 W, 2400/5650 MHz 10 W; mobile HF 50 W PEP; at feed-line input
levels.notes: No 160/60/20/17/15/12m. Satellite allowed. CA prefix.

levels.name: General
levels.powerNote: Fixed: <30 MHz 1200 W PEP, VHF 100 W, UHF<=1270 MHz 50 W, >1270 MHz 10 W; mobile: 200 W PEP HF, 50 W VHF, 25 W UHF, 10 W >1270; at feed-line input
levels.notes: All bands in the national plan (160m only 1800-1850, 80m only 3500-3750, 3cm only 10.45-10.5 GHz). CE prefix (also used by clubs).

levels.notes: Same bands as General (use General's table) plus temporary (<7 days) use of internationally allocated amateur bands not allocated in Chile and temporary higher-power experimental permits (Art. 9 e). XQ prefix.

jurisdictions.callsignInference: Prefix encodes category: XQ = Superior, CE = General (or club/state station), CA = Novicio (3-letter suffix), CD = Aspirante (3-letter suffix). CB/XR/3G = special event (Superior/General/clubs), level unknown. CE#/homecall = foreign IARP visitor. High reliability for XQ/CA/CD; CE ambiguous only with club stations.

jurisdictions.rules: Decreto 2.836/1993 Reglamento sobre el Servicio de Radioaficionados (G.O. 35.194) + Instructivo Técnico-Administrativo (Aug 1995)

levels.name: Class A
levels.powerNote: HF 200 W PEP; VHF 25 W PEP; UHF 5 W PEP; SHF 5 W PEP
levels.notes: Excluded: 160, 30, 20, 17, 12m, 2m, 70cm (and 33cm per one copy). Digital limited to RTTY/ASCII/packet/AMTOR; no PACTOR/CLOVER/fax/SSTV. levels.name: Limited licence

levels.name: Full licence

jurisdictions.callsignInference: Existing LA/LB personal calls (and LC contest calls) = Full (A). Begrenset lisens gets a class-identifying series 'fastsatt av Nkom' that was not yet published as of 2026-10; until known, inference for new calls is unavailable.

levels.name: Category D

jurisdictions.callsignInference: Lower bound only. Group A (Extra-only) formats imply Extra; Group B implies Advanced or Extra; Group C implies Technician or higher; Group D gives no information. Contiguous US: 1x2 and 2x1 (K/N/W, two-letter A/K/N/W prefixes) and 2x2 with AA-AK prefix = Group A; 2x2 with K/N/W two-letter prefix = Group B; 1x3 = Group C; 2x3 = Group D. Puerto Rico (KP/NP/WP 3 or 4): 2x1 = A, KP#XX = B, NP#XX/WP#XX = C, KP#XXX/WP#XXX = D. Calls never change on upgrade, so current class can be higher than the group implies. levels.notes: Single issued level since 2012. Legacy classe 1 (F2/F3/F5/F6/F8/F9) and classe 2 (F1/F4) have identical privileges. New calls F4.

jurisdictions.callsignInference: F0 = classe 3 (legacy, 2m 10 W only). Any other F+digit = HAREC privileges. Pre-2012 digit history: 5/6/8 = classe 1, 1/4 = classe 2, 0 = classe 3. Only digit 4 issued since April 2012.

jurisdictions.termLocal: Fähigkeitszeugnis (DE) / certificat de capacité (FR); formerly Konzession

levels.name: Novice
levels.nameLocal: Einsteigerausweis für Funkamateurinnen und Funkamateure (Fähigkeitszeugnis Novice)
levels.powerNote: PEP transmitter output; 50 W on 2m/70cm
levels.notes: VNF Art. 45(2): Morse, radiotelephony, facsimile; no television (ATV). 'image' here means facsimile/SSTV only. Digital modes allowed per BAKOM Merkblatt 1.8.

levels.name: Full (CEPT)
levels.powerNote: PEP transmitter output; exceptions per range

ranges.note: >20 W only after notification to OFCOM

levels.notes: Also covers legacy Radiotelegrafistenausweis and Radiotelefonistenausweis für den Amateurfunk (VNF Art. 44(1)(a) Ziff. 2-3; same rights per Art. 45(1)). Old Konzession classes 1/2 map here.

jurisdictions.callsignInference: HB3 + 3 letters = Novice; HB9 + 3 letters = Full. HB9 + 2 letters = clubs (some old personal). HB1/2/4-8 = club contest/military; other HB specials not inferable. Reliable: calls are certificate-bound and cannot be changed.
